Sharm El-Sheikh: City Tour with Optional Seafood Meal

Sharm El-Sheikh: City Tour with Optional Seafood Meal

No active options
  • Product Id: 844930
  • Product Reference Code: SHR-CTFR-01
  • Rating:
    4.7 of 5
  • Preview on website
Short description

Explore Sharm El-Sheikh’s top highlights, from mosques to markets, with an optional seafood meal at the famous Fares Restaurant. A perfect mix of culture, shopping, and flavor in one tour!

Full description
Discover the best of Sharm El-Sheikh on this enriching city tour that blends culture, shopping, and optional fine dining. Begin your journey with a visit to the stunning Al Mustafa Mosque, known for its grand architecture, followed by a stop at the iconic El Sahaba Mosque in the heart of the Old Market. Enjoy free time to stroll through the bustling market, where you can shop for souvenirs, spices, handmade crafts, and more. As an optional highlight, treat yourself to a delicious seafood meal at the renowned Fares Restaurant, famous for its fresh catch and authentic flavors. Whether you're seeking cultural insights, local shopping treasures, or a tasty ending to your day, this tour offers it all in one experience.
Highlights
  • Visit Al Mustafa Mosque and El Sahaba Mosque
  • Explore the vibrant Old Market
  • Enjoy free time for shopping and local exploration
  • Discover top city spots like Naama Bay or SOHO Square
  • Optional seafood dinner at the famous Fares Restaurant

Inclusions

Hotel pickup and drop-off
Transportation in a air-conditioned car

FTS Organic 100% oils (if add-on selected)

Traditional art dance (if the Panorama cafe option is selected)
